import { Content as KotlinUiReadme } from "../../../../../../../sdks/kotlin/ui/README.md";

The Kotlin SDK's Compose UI kit. It provides the boot shell, the gate, activation, sign-in with a
QR code, settings, devices, the update banner and prompt, and pack progress for native Android apps.
This page renders `sdks/kotlin/ui/README.md` whole, so there is exactly one copy to keep current.
The rest of the Kotlin SDK is described in `sdks/kotlin/README.md`.
